summary: A banking backend built with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, and Docker using Event Sourcing and CQRS. The event store is the source of truth, projections serve read queries, snapshots improve replay performance, and transaction IDs provide idempotency for monetary commands.

snapshotStrategy.loadApproach: Load latest snapshot and replay only the remaining events

queries: Get balance at a specific timestamp
businessRules: Cannot operate on a closed account
Transaction IDs must be unique for idempotent monetary commands

querySide.description: Read paginated transaction history from projection
Read full event stream for audit
Read account balance at a point in time

system.description: Rebuild read models from the event store

dockerSetup.databaseInitialization: PostgreSQL schema and sample data are loaded from the seeds directory

implementationHighlights: Write operations append immutable events instead of directly mutating state
Read APIs use projections for fast queries
Aggregate state is rebuilt from snapshot plus remaining events
Deposit and withdrawal commands are idempotent using transactionId
Projection rebuild endpoint supports recovery of read models
